people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Ornan
people.line: Jebusite, sold threshing floor to David

translations.web: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
translations.bsb: David came to Ornan, and when Ornan looked out and saw David, he left the threshing floor and bowed facedown before David.
translations.kjv: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
translations.asv: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing-floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
